summary_1line: Yudhishthira mourns the fiery deaths of Dhritarashtra, Gandhari, and Kunti; Narada explains the sacred cause, and the Pandavas perform funeral rites on the Ganga.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira stands in the palace weeping while the Pandava brothers and courtiers embrace and cry as the lamentations echo through the halls.
On the banks of the Ganga, the Pandavas dressed in single garments pour water offerings into the river for Dhritarashtra, Gandhari, and Kunti.
An aged Dhritarashtra in the forest sits in meditation as a great wildfire spreads through the trees, consuming the hermitage.
